title: Wholesome Algerian White Bread Bake
description: A pungent, shaggy, kid-friendly Algerian dish featuring white bread mix, salt-bake, and high-protein ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the white bread mix, water, salt, and olive oil.
Mix the dough until it forms a sticky ball.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Roll out the dough into a rectangle and spread the flaxseed meal evenly over it.
Drizzle the honey over the flaxseed meal.
Crack the egg into the dough and mix it in.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and cilantro over the dough.
Bake the bread for 25 minutes or until it's golden brown.
Remove the bread from the oven and crumble the feta cheese over it.
Let the bread cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
